3558-3967-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-3967-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7279-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7279-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Razorkin Hordecaller as attackers.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

856-5776-7396-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Spark Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1824-2060-7889.easyPrerequisites: You haven't completed, or are currently venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-2060-7889.description:
Cast Acererak the Archlich by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Acererak the Archlich spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to venture into any dungeon except Tomb of Annihilation.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{B}.
Repeat.

An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

3259-7175-7686.description:

The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1017-3532-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1017-3532-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it

193-2724-3908-6432.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary.
Repeat each turn.

3490-5231-5870-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-5870-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

101-372-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2921-3215-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

618-4050-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2921-5220-6537-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-4890.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dack's Duplicate.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Dack's Duplicate by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1434-1744-6567.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
1434-1744-6567.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 60 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

1283-1995-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
1283-1995-3918.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability.

1849-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2608-3717-4499.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness, and has power 3 or greater.
2608-3717-4499.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat.

647-1170-1328-2105.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
647-1170-1328-2105.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

884-1339-1636-2302.notablePrerequisites:
Ayara does not have summoning sickness.
"Black" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You control at least one additional creature.
884-1339-1636-2302.description:
Activate Ayara by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1459-3908-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Spark Double enters, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Spark Double triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
